IC1: Patients who have received prior chemotherapy [AND] for unresectable disease
IC2: Patients with any active or uncontrolled infection, including known HIV infection. (Patients with active hepatitis B [AND] will be placed on lamivudine. Patients with active hepatitis C [AND] will be eligible if liver tests qualify (5.1.9)
IC3: Patients with psychiatric disorders that would interfere with consent [OR] or follow-up. Pregnant [OR] or lactating women. Men and women of reproductive potential [AND] may not participate unless they have agreed to use an effective contraceptive method.
IC4: Patients with any other severe concurrent disease, which in the judgment of the investigator, would make the patient inappropriate for entry into this study.
